context_requirements: Expression of CHRNA3 or ALPPL2, or intact innate immune signaling (TLR/NF-kB/IRF) for downstream immunostimulant effects
Functional NF-kB and interferon signaling components
For antiproliferative/immunogenic effects, intact antigen presentation and cytokine response machinery
falsifiers: No induction of NF-kB target genes (NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, RELB, NFKB2) or interferon-stimulated genes (STAT1, HLA-DRA, PSMB8, UBE2L6) at 6 or 24 h in any cell line
No change in cytokine/chemokine landmark genes (CXCL2, CCL2, IL1B, PTGS2) at 24 h
Absence of any transcriptional response across all nine cell lines
Strong proliferation gene induction rather than the expected downregulation
